proof_body:
by
  intro a b ha hb
  have hsa := Real.sq_sqrt ha
  have hsb := Real.sq_sqrt hb
  have na := Real.sqrt_nonneg a
  have nb := Real.sqrt_nonneg b
  have hab : 0 ≤ a + b := add_nonneg ha hb
  refine ⟨Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨add_nonneg na nb, by nlinarith [mul_nonneg na nb]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hab
    rw [h] at hs
    have hp : Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp with h0 | h0
    · rw [(Real.sqrt_eq_zero ha).mp h0, zero_mul]
    · rw [(Real.sqrt_eq_zero hb).mp h0, mul_zero]
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]
      simp
    · rw [h0]
      simp
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → Real.sqrt (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b ∧ (Real.sqrt (a + b) = Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b ↔ a * b = 0)
